files.name: submission.csv
files.note: Preferred path: submission_dir/submission.csv; evaluator also globs submission_dir/**/submission.csv and takes the first match.

columns.name: year
columns.note: Parsed as int(float(row['year'])). Part of the composite key (year, state_id, county_id) that must match the evaluator's private test set.

columns.name: state_id
columns.note: Parsed as int(float(row['state_id'])). Part of the composite key.

columns.name: county_id
columns.note: Parsed as int(float(row['county_id'])). Part of the composite key.

columns.name: predicted_yield
columns.note: Parsed as float(row['predicted_yield']). Must be finite (not NaN, not Inf). The agent's soybean yield prediction in bushels/acre.

aliases.note: The evaluator checks column names as exact literals (lines 116-119). No .get() alias chains exist in evaluator code. The EXTRACTOR_SPEC docstring (lines 3-20) lists aliases for the *extractor* to normalize before copying the file (state->state_id, county->county_id, pred/yield/prediction/predicted->predicted_yield), but the evaluator itself requires the canonical names above.

structural_checks: submission.csv must exist under submission_dir (searched recursively if not at top level)
HC1: all four columns [year, state_id, county_id, predicted_yield] must be present as literal header names
file must not be empty (at least one data row)
HC2: year, state_id, county_id must each be parseable as int(float(x)); predicted_yield must be parseable as a finite float (no NaN, no Inf)
HC3: no duplicate (year, state_id, county_id) triples
HC4: the set of (year, state_id, county_id) triples must equal the evaluator's private test set exactly — no missing rows, no extra rows
